findings.title: High-precision J0 promotion returns a BALL with an infeasible stale binary64 center
findings.description: The fallback computes a higher-precision center internally but returns only J0/error. identified() promotes BALL and clears uncertainty while retaining s0 and R calculated before the fallback. On an exact-binary near-pure target, the reported center lies outside the true identified ball: its exact minimum required budget is10.413783481177918 times rho squared. This is an incorrect set geometry even though J0, side classification, and radius are accurate.
findings.consequence: A consumer can select the returned center, supposedly the safest member of the reported ball, and receive a target for which no foreground within the declared budget exists.
findings.minimal_fix: Return coherent numerically controlled center/residual/radius and serialization-aware uncertainty; use typed HOLD when the reported translated geometry is unresolved.

When a bounded high-precision calculation is used, retain a coherent center, irreducible cost, metric/ell accuracy and residual derived from the same exact binary64 F,d,a,Y inputs; do not update only J0 while returning the old binary64 center/residual. Account explicitly for conversion/serialization of every one of the24 center coordinates and the radius, for the relation R=Y-a*s_center^T, and for arithmetic in rho squared and radius extraction. Returning a rounded high-precision center alone is insufficient when its conversion error is appreciable relative to the small ball. Derive a homogeneous bound on the center Euclidean error and radius error (including retained ell error), propagate it into the squared-budget image, and use it with the unchanged relative1e-9 numerical policy. The identity J(s_hat+v)=J0+ell2*||s_hat+v-s0||^2 implies a boundary budget error term bounded by ell2*(2*r*delta_s+delta_s^2), plus radius/J0/ell errors; use this or an equivalent justified bound across the full24 directions. Return a typed NUMERIC_BOUNDARY_HOLD or BOUNDARY_UNCERTAIN with radius=None when the translated set cannot be resolved at the declared numerical policy; alternatively an explicitly bounded uncertainty image must retain its uncertainty and must not be reported as the exact translated BALL. Do not clear uncertainty merely because J0 itself converged, certify a singleton from near equality, force a residual to zero, truncate a direction, add an amplitude floor, or weaken an oracle/tolerance. Exact repeated-row/zero-budget structural certificates remain separate and unchanged. Include a mixed signed24 carrier to exercise transport and accumulation of serialization error. Independently validate minimum budget at the actual returned/serialized center, and validate boundary/directional witnesses or a justified full error image; typed uncertainty is required where geometry is unrepresentable at sufficient precision. An exact-rational row-contrast solve using H rows e_i-e_0 is available in this review and avoids the consumer's K-inverse/Schur-complement cancellation oracle. Preserve old29, all current structural/domain/null tests and generic EMPTY/equality/BALL controls. New assertions must check coherent outputs, not only status/J0 or a center tolerance measured against the large common target. Re-execute only affected cached consumer/tests and necessary packaging, retain first failures, show parity of unchanged12 metric outputs and all six NPZ sets, and return the exact candidate for fresh independent review. No cosmetic PDF changes are requested. No reintegration, WMAP extension, sky/catalogue/noise/native/ODE run, physical-model change, new ultra allocation, accounting reset, full provenance rerun or original42 promotion.
